title: Painted Cube
statement: A $10\times10\times10$ cube is painted on the outside and cut into $1000$ unit cubes. How many unit cubes have paint on exactly two faces?
insight: Exactly two painted faces means lying on an edge but not at a corner: 12 edges with 8 such cubes each.
redHerring: Subtracting the counts for 0, 1 and 3 painted faces from 1000.
hints: Where on the big cube does a small cube touch exactly two outer faces?
On an edge but not a corner.
How many non-corner cubes lie on each edge, and how many edges are there?
solution: A small cube has two painted faces iff it lies on an edge of the big cube but not at a corner. Each of the 12 edges has $10 - 2 = 8$ such cubes: $12\cdot8 = 96$.
